entries.title: Zechariah 3:1
segments: ¶And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the Angel of Jehovah, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:2
segments: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Jehovah rebuke thee, O Satan! Yea, Jehovah that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee! Is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

entries.title: Zechariah 3:3
segments: And Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the Angel.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:4
segments: And he spoke and said unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from off him. And unto him he said, See, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I clothe thee with festival-robes.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:5
segments: And I said, Let them set a pure turban upon his head. And they set the pure turban upon his head, and clothed him with garments; and the Angel of Jehovah stood by.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:6
segments: And the Angel of Jehovah protested unto Joshua, saying,

entries.title: Zechariah 3:7
segments: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts; and I will give thee a place to walk among these that stand by.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:8
segments: ¶Hear now, Joshua the high priest, thou and thy fellows that sit before thee--for they are men of portent--for behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:9
segments: For behold, the stone that I have laid before Joshua--upon one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in one day.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:10
segments: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall ye invite every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig-tree.
